backup_name: EVE Drawing Quote Checker before AUX_005 total adjustment
purpose: Restore point immediately before changing AUX_005 input from Compatible Units subtotal to DQM quote Total internal-cost value.
current_aux005_input: Compatible Units subtotal on the DQM Cost Summary (e.g. $20,615.38 for SP053602).
requested_aux005_input: First Total value on the DQM Cost Summary, i.e. Total Internal Costs (e.g. $23,308.88 for SP053602).
formula_before_change: Expected AUX_005 = 4 × ceil((input total - quoted AUX_005 quantity × $174.13) / $10,000), minimum 0.
note: This branch preserves all repo files at the time of backup. Standalone copies below preserve exact current frontend and deployed backend source. Do not add secrets to source control.
